title: ChatGPT 6 Astra: OpenAI Unveils Its Most Powerful AI Yet | Explained
description:
OpenAI has launched ChatGPT 6 Astra, describing it as its most advanced AI model ever. Unlike traditional chatbots, Astra is designed to execute complex workflows, analyze files directly from a user's device and function more like a digital co-worker. The launch has reignited the debate around AI safety, autonomy and the path toward Artificial General Intelligence.
